Problem.description: An RFC 9457 problem document. This is the entry point's default error shape, which a host-supplied ErrorResponder may replace.

detail.description: A longer explanation of this occurrence, present only when the answering module has one to give. It may be a sentence rendered in the request language or a language-neutral token such as "forbidden", so clients must not parse it.

instance.description: A URI identifying this occurrence; absent when there is none to give.

status.description: The HTTP status code the response is written with, repeated from the status line.

title.description: A short summary of the kind of problem. A module that sets none gets the standard English status text for the status code.

type.description: The machine-readable code identifying the kind of problem. A module that sets none gets the RFC 9457 default about:blank; codes this platform defines are URNs of the form urn:speed:<capability>:<code>.

get.description: Answers the permission names the calling principal effectively holds, as the union over the roles it is bound to in each domain: platform for the platform domain, and tenant for the tenant the request resolved to. A request that resolved no tenant answers an empty tenant list. A held (object, action) pair that no declared permission translates to is left out, and a permission reached through several roles appears once. A policy that cannot be read is a 503, never an empty list.

schema.description: The permissions the calling principal holds in the two policy domains.

platform.description: The permission names the principal holds in the platform domain, sorted ascending. Empty when it holds none there.

tenant.description: The permission names the principal holds in the tenant the request resolved to, sorted ascending. Empty when the request resolved no tenant, or the principal holds none there.

200.description: The permissions the caller holds in the platform domain and in the request's tenant

503.description: The policy snapshot or its store could not answer

get.summary: List the permissions the caller holds
